node.title: Re: Running local Perl from HTML
node.author: choroba
node.doctext:
Running a local web server isn't ridiculous. You don't have to install anything heavyweight like Apache, things like [metamod://Dancer2] have their own simple webserver included which should be more than enough for your purposes.

Also, if you just want to run the whole stuff locally, what about editing the table in a non-web GUI (like [metamod://Tk]) and outputting the final HTML table at the end?
